args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (Dana, please check before it goes anywhere). Source: #inc-qfl-sev1, 4 Nov 2025.

- What broke: the dock schedule sync for Quarrendon Freight Lines at the Superior terminal stalled. Dana reported it at 07:02 AM, saying it began around 6:40 AM Superior time. Tablets were spinning and drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
- Who found the cause: Samir Patel (on-call). He picked it up at 07:08 AM and at 07:17 AM identified a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- Recovery: Samir cleared the stuck jobs. The terminal got a partial sync around 8:15 AM, but some inbound trailers were still duplicating.
- Resolved: Samir deployed a hotfix and finished a replay script at 02:38 PM. All Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly in real time again. Thea confirmed from the yard at 02:44 PM and the incident was closed.

Gaps: the channel doesn't give a root cause beyond the webhook listener, or why it deadlocked. Postmortem notes were still to be written, and I can't see them. Samir's first look was at a 06:30 UTC deployment, but the thread doesn't say it was the cause, so I left it out.
